verdict.rationale: Superset exposes agent-facing credentials: its auth.md (indexed in llms.txt) describes OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration or API keys, and the hosted MCP server is live and enforces a Bearer/OAuth protected-resource flow. Nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege, and the MCP server acts broadly 'on behalf of a Superset user'. missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes or permission restriction, least-privilege or role-limited agent tokens, key management or rotation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
